verdict.rationale: Framework coverage is a fair question for a compliance-automation platform like Drata, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions ISO 27001, the Annex A control set, a Statement of Applicability, or certification-audit artifacts. The only related evidence is generic API endpoints (custom frameworks, control requirement mappings, list audits), which shows mapping-level plumbing rather than first-class ISO 27001 support.
